🎥🎬: Hereditary (2018)

After the death of her secretive mother, Annie Graham begins uncovering disturbing secrets about her family’s past. As strange events begin surrounding Annie, her husband Steve, and their children Peter and Charlie, the family is pushed toward a terrifying truth they cannot escape.

When tragedy strikes, Annie becomes desperate to understand what is happening, only to discover that her family has been caught in a sinister supernatural plan for generations. As reality begins to collapse around them, the Grahams are forced into a horrifying battle against a fate that was set in motion long before they knew it existed.

source_details.synopsis: Hereditary is a 2018 American supernatural psychological horror film written and directed by Ari Aster in his feature directorial debut. Starring Toni Collette, Alex Wolff, Milly Shapiro, Ann Dowd, and Gabriel Byrne, the film follows Annie Graham (Collette), a grieving miniature artist who uncovers disturbing secrets about her recently deceased mother. She is subsequently tormented by sinister paranormal occurrences, along with her husband Steve (Byrne) and their children, Peter (Wolff) and Charlie (Shapiro). Aster's work on short horror films, most notably The Strange Thing About the Johnsons, attracted the attention of A24, who greenlit Hereditary as his first feature film. Aster conceived
